outputs.prompt: Make this antique brass key visibly thicker and bolder while preserving its recognizable design and current warm muted gold and brown colors. Increase the material thickness of the long narrow shaft, the circular bow ring, and the small teeth so the key feels sturdy and reads clearly as a small inventory icon. Keep the circular opening clearly open. Preserve the upright orientation with the ring at the top and the teeth projecting to the right at the bottom, the overall length, placement and simple restrained shading. Retain a thin dark outer outline; make the brass body thicker rather than merely adding a heavy black border. Keep the same key, with no ornaments or new parts.
